jobs.description:
ABOUT THE JOB
 
 

• Advising clients ranging from innovative start-ups to multinational companies on trademark, design and related IP matters. 

• Managing national, European and international trademark and design portfolios. 

• Conducting trademark clearance searches and providing availability opinions. 

• Drafting, filing and prosecuting trademark and design applications before the BOIP, EUIPO, WIPO and foreign intellectual property offices. 

• Handling opposition, cancellation and invalidity proceedings. 

• Advising on infringement, unfair competition and IP enforcement strategies. 

• Drafting legal opinions, cease-and-desist letters, coexistence agreements, assignments and licence agreements. 

• Assisting clients in developing and implementing pragmatic IP protection strategies. 

• Liaising with clients, foreign associates and intellectual property offices worldwide. 

• Monitoring legislative and case law developments and translating these into practical advice for clients. 

• Working closely with a team of experienced attorneys, legal professionals and paralegals.  

YOUR PROFILE
 
 

• Education: Master's degree in Law, preferably with an additional qualification in Intellectual Property. 

• Experience: Some experience in IP law and/or trademark and design protection, preferably in private practice. 

• Languages: Excellent written and oral communication skills in Dutch and English; other languages are a plus. 

• Mindset: Pragmatic, proactive, client-oriented, and self-motivated. 

• Skills: Attention to detail, ability to handle confidential cases discreetly, and strong prioritization skills. 

• Teamwork: Ability to work both individually and seamlessly within a team.

For our client, we are looking for a motivated INDUSTRIAL CLEANER.
 

 
• Assisting with emptying the tunnels (partially mechanical/partially manual)
 
• Cleaning large tunnels using a high-pressure cleaner
 
• Assisting with filling the tunnels
 
• Thinking along when adding quantities of spawn
 
• Cleaning transport belts at height (no fear of heights!) 

What do we expect from you as an industrial cleaner?
 

 
• You have some initial experience as an industrial cleaner
 
• You are in good physical health and not afraid to work in a dirty environment
 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system (5-13 & 13-21)
 
• You actively contribute to the cleaning process
 
• You are a team player but can also work independently
 
• You speak Dutch, French or English

Are you an experienced CE driver who enjoys being on the road and likes variety? For a growing transport company in Desteldonk (Ghent), we are looking for a motivated CE driver for Benelux distribution.

You will work in a professional environment with a clear schedule, fixed arrangements and personal support. Safety, reliability and quality service are key. After successfully completing the Ecodrive, you will also receive a company car for private use.

Your job

• Carry out distribution trips throughout the Benelux
• Drive to a variety of destinations, including East Flanders, Limburg and locations across the border
• Transport goods safely and on time
• Regularly load and unload goods yourself via the loading dock or curtain side
• Warehouse staff can take over loading and unloading when needed
• Provide professional and customer-oriented service
• Drive your own fixed truck, departing daily from Desteldonk
• Possibility to work for a fixed customer, providing extra structure and regularity

• You have a valid CE driving licence and some initial experience as a driver
• You are punctual, responsible and customer-oriented
• You work safely and professionally
• You are flexible and enjoy variety in your work
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are motivated and proud of your profession

Are you a CE driver who enjoys being on the road but wants to be home every evening? For a growing transport company in Desteldonk (Ghent), we are looking for a motivated CE driver for shuttle and regional work.

You can count on a clear schedule, a stable work structure and daily departure from Desteldonk. After successfully completing the Ecodrive, you will also receive a company car for private use.

Your job

• Carry out shuttle and distribution trips for various customers (no shops, only industrial companies)
• Mainly drive within the Ghent region
• Transport goods safely and on time
• Loading and unloading is only occasionally done by you via the loading dock or curtain side; warehouse staff usually take care of this
• Provide professional and customer-oriented service
• Possibility to work for a fixed customer, offering extra structure and regularity
• Start each day from Desteldonk
• No overnight stays – home every evening

• You have a valid CE driving licence and some initial experience as a driver
• You are punctual, responsible and customer-oriented
• You work safely and professionally
• You are flexible and enjoy variety in your work
• You speak Dutch or English
• You are motivated and proud of your profession
• You are available to start between 5:00 and 6:00 AM

Are you looking for an active night shift job in a cold (-22°C) and stable working environment?
Then this might be your new challenge!

You will be working for a rapidly growing logistics company that distributes frozen products.

As an Order Picker, you are an indispensable link in the logistics process. You ensure that orders are prepared and shipped without errors.

- You collect frozen products using a pick list and scanner.
- You stack boxes correctly on pallets according to the instructions.
- You prepare orders for shipment and place pallets in the correct location.
- You work with an electric pallet truck.
- You strictly follow safety and quality rules.
- Vaardigheden:
You have experience as an order picker or logistics employee.
You are familiar with working with an electric pallet truck.
You can work without any problems in a frozen environment of -22°C.
You enjoy active work.
You work accurately, are reliable, and think in terms of the team.

- Attesten:
Certificate for electric pallet truck is a plus, but not mandatory.

- Opleidingsvereisten:
No diploma required.

- Talenkennis:
Good knowledge of English

The Production/Finishing Department has an exciting opportunity for a results-driven Process Engineer.

Purpose of the Role

You will develop and implement manufacturing methods to ensure production is carried out in the safest, highest-quality, and most cost-effective manner.

Working from within the production environment, you will collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering & Maintenance, Supply Chain, Business teams, and other stakeholders to improve safety, quality, delivery performance, and productivity. 

Key Responsibilities
 
• Investigate and resolve issues arising during the manufacturing process. 
• Drive operational excellence initiatives by identifying improvement opportunities, reducing losses, optimizing processes, and improving equipment reliability. 
• Identify and analyze process improvement opportunities to enhance productivity, quality, safety, and cost efficiency, and lead improvement projects across production and supporting departments. 
• Facilitate and support change management activities. 
• Ensure that improvements are properly documented, standardized, and embedded within operational processes. 
Profile / Qualifications
 
• Master's degree or an experienced Professional Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Industrial Sciences, Manufacturing, Operations Management, or a related technical field. 
• Proven experience in a manufacturing or production environment. 
• Experience with process analysis, data analysis, and performance management. 
• Knowledge of Power BI, OT/IT systems, Six Sigma, or similar analytical tools is considered an asset. 
• Fluent in Dutch and English. 
• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills. 
• Hands-on mentality with the ability to translate ideas into practical improvements. 
• Effective communication skills with the ability to engage a variety of stakeholders. 
• Ability to work both independently and within multidisciplinary teams.

As a 
Claims Handler, you will manage maritime and transport claims from A to Z. You will act as a key contact for our clients and coordinate the different parties involved throughout the claims process.
 

Your day-to-day work includes assessing incoming claims, coordinating surveys, reviewing documentation and reports, investigating the cause and extent of damage, calculating claim amounts and preparing final reports. You will also maintain close contact with brokers, exporters, insurers, surveyors, lawyers and other partners, representing the interests of our clients throughout the process.
 

The role offers a high degree of 
autonomy and 
responsibility, combined with an international and varied range of contacts.

We are looking for a proactive and organised person with an analytical mindset and strong communication skills. You enjoy taking ownership of cases, working with different stakeholders and finding practical solutions for clients.
 

Experience or knowledge in 
claims, insurance, logistics, transport or the 
 maritime sector is an advantage, but is not a requirement.
 

We are equally interested in candidates with a relevant background and a strong willingness to learn.
 

You are comfortable working in an international environment and have a strong command of 
English, both written and spoken.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry in Zottegem, is currently looking for a motivated operator to join the packaging department in a 2 shift system.

What will your responsibilities be?
As a packaging operator, you are an essential link in our client’s production process.
Multitasking, precision and working at a fast pace are your strengths.

Your responsibilities:
 
• You will mainly be responsible for packaging the finished products. 
• You will regularly carry out quality checks. 
• You will ensure that packaging materials are supplied to the production line. 
• You will set up your machine and keep it running smoothly. 
• Labelling and logistical tasks will also be part of your responsibilities. 
• Finally, you will ensure a clean and tidy working environment.
The working hours are from Monday till Friday in a 2 shiftsystem:
early shift: 06:00–14:00
late shift: 14:00–22:00
 
• You have some previous experience in a production environment, preferably in the food industry. 
• You are available to start soon. 
• You speak Dutch and/or English fluently. 
• You are conscientious and enjoy working efficiently. 
• You are an excellent multitasker. 
• You can work well both independently and as part of a team. 
• Working at a fast pace is not a problem for you. 
• You are enthusiastic and eager to learn. 
• You are specifically looking for a job in 2 shifts. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

Our client, a well-established company in the food production industry located in Zottegem, is looking for a motivated and experienced Technical Operator.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
As a Technical Operator, you play a crucial role in the production process.

You ensure that the production lines run efficiently and intervene quickly whenever deviations occur. Thanks to your technical insight, accuracy, and problem-solving skills, production continues smoothly.

Your responsibilities:
 
• Setting up, operating, and monitoring production lines. 
• Performing quality checks and making adjustments where necessary. 
• Detecting technical malfunctions and independently resolving minor defects. 
• Carrying out machine changeovers, cleaning your equipment, and ensuring machines function correctly. 
• Recording production data and strictly following established procedures. 
• Assisting with preventive maintenance and actively contributing ideas for process improvements. 
• Maintaining a safe, clean, and organized work environment at all times.
Working hours are from Monday to Friday in a two-shift system:
 
• Morning shift: 6:00 AM – 2:00 PM 
• Afternoon shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
 
• You have previous experience as a Technical Operator. 
• You have a strong technical interest and are eager to learn. 
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. 
• You have a good command of Dutch and/or English. 
• You work accurately, responsibly, and have a strong focus on quality. 
• You can independently analyze and solve technical issues. 
• You perform well in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues. 
• You are stress-resistant and thrive in a production environment where pace is important. 
• You have a hands-on mentality and enjoy taking initiative. 
• You have your own transportation or can easily commute to the workplace. 
• You live within a 20 km radius of Zottegem.

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Zottegem.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Do you like to work in the heart of Gent city? We're looking for you!

Together with functional experts, scrum masters, UX designers and other developers, you will work in an inspiring, high-paced and fun environment. We work on software projects according to the agile methodology (SCRUM) and in close collaboration with our customers.
Role
As a Java developer your input will help shape the future of the company, we will count on you to coach other developers and steer our approach for various projects.

You are able to work closely together with the business, willing to go the extra mile and love to tackle new challenges. You get excited about new technologies and are always eager to learn more.

Profile
• You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in any of the following technologies: Java, Spring Boot framework, NodeJS, designing and implementing RESTful API’s

• Also interested in frontend development? We work mostly with Angular, React and React Native.

• Experience with Google Cloud Platform, Azure or AWS is a plus

• Preferably you have a master's or bachelor’s degree in IT

• You are able to help set up the architecture for our projects, selecting the right technologies to serve the business need and review UI designs

• You are willing to develop yourself and learn new technologies

• You are fluent in English + Dutch or French is a must.

jobs.occupation: Business Development Manager Industial & Technical Solutions
jobs.description:
HQ Antwerp | Coverage: Europe (with potential EMEA expansion)| Business Development Manager| Energy, Oil & Gas

About the Company
Our client is an international technology organization with a strong footprint across Europe. The company designs and delivers advanced software and hardware solutions for complex industrial environments in the oil & gas industry, helping customers operate safely, efficiently and in full regulatory compliance.

 

Your New Role
 
As Business Development Manager, you are responsible for driving new business growth across Europe. You focus on opening new doors, building long-term commercial relationships and developing a sustainable opportunity pipeline within large, complex organizations.
 
This is a pure new business role with a long-term perspective. You will work on strategic target accounts with lengthy investment cycles, where success depends on trust-building, market insight, and persistence rather than short-term wins.
 
You work closely with the Sales Manager and internal technical teams and operate in a hybrid model combining office-based work, customer visits and international travel.
 
Key Responsibilities

• Identify, approach and develop new customers and new opportunities across European markets
• Map target regions, industries and strategic accounts and define focused action plans
• Establish relationships with key decision-makers within complex organizations
• Build and manage a qualitative sales pipeline through continuous prospecting and follow-up
• Understand customer processes, strategic challenges and long-term investment roadmaps
• Prepare and deliver tailored presentations, demonstrations and commercial proposals
• Collaborate with internal engineering and solution teams to translate business needs into technical solutions
• Represent the organization at customer meetings, industry events and conferences
• Maintain structured reporting and pipeline management through CRM tools
• Contribute to long-term growth strategy, forecasting and market development initiatives
 

Your Profile

• At least 3 years of experience in Business Development within a technical or industrial environment
• Educational background in engineering, industrial technology or IT, or equivalent technical-commercial experience
• Experience or affinity with industries such as energy, process industry, industrial systems or infrastructure is a plus
• Demonstrated ability to generate new business, open new accounts and build relationships from the ground up
• Strong hunter mentality with resilience and confidence in approaching senior stakeholders
• Comfortable operating in environments with long sales cycles and high-value investment projects
• Strong communication and presentation skills at executive and technical levels
• Languages: English and Dutch are mandatory; additional European languages (German or French) German is a plusWillingness to travel regularly (short, project-based trips)

Solution Design:

• You’ll get to analyse the client’s requirements, create the best solution design for them and write up an attractive offer.
• You’ll be engineering solutions (video, voice over IP and radio) within complex IT and software integration projects, to be used in mission critical control-room environments.
• You’ll carry out presentations and demonstrations of our solutions.
• You’ll lend your support to Key Account Managers during solution positioning and proposal negotiations.
• You’ll get to advise the Project Engineers on the actual implementation of your design at the client.
• You’ll have the freedom to look for alternative solutions if they’re needed to meet the client’s requirements.
 

Tender management:

• You’ll get to manage the bidding process.
• You’ll apply internal risk management processes during the offer stage.
• You’ll be in charge of detecting and documenting potential risks associated with different projects.
• You’ll get to follow up with partners and internal stakeholders involved in the tender process.

Education, Knowledge & Work Experience:

• Are you an industrial Engineer IT/Electronics, or do you have a master in ICT or equivalent experience?
• Do you have several years of relevant technical experience with the delivery of customized solutions? And have you already had some client contact? 
• Are you interested in one of the following technologies: voice over IP, video over IP, radio technology, and software platforms for control rooms?
• Knowledge - Expertise with IP networks (LAN, WAN, Wireless, VPN, etc.) and IT (Virtual machines, Windows servers, etc.)?
• Do you have a good grasp of how to integrate specific software modules and identify the matching IT platform (e.g. OPC-DA/UA, web API’s (SOAP, REST))?
Required skills:

• Are you great at face-to-face meetings with clients, and do you naturally empathize with their needs?
• Do you have a way with words? Do you know just how to give a text a logical structure and make a solution description appealing to clients?
• Is organized your middle name? Are you autonomous and results-driven, and would never miss a deadline?
• Is technology where your passion lies?
• Are you fully comfortable in Dutch and fluent in English? Knowledge of French is an asset.
• Holder of a driver licence B

jobs.occupation: Change Manager – IS Transformation & Cyber Security
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

• Define and implement the global change management strategy and roadmap for the transformation and cybersecurity programs.
• Conduct impact assessments to map organizational, business, and technical changes across the department.
• Develop comprehensive communication plans and campaigns to foster a proactive security culture.
• Establish and support a network of change ambassadors and security champions to promote new ways of working.
• Coach project managers, product owners, and critical teams on adoption strategies and resistance management.
• Monitor and report on adoption progress using ADKAR indicators and established KPIs.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in change management utilizing the ADKAR methodology.
• 5+ years of experience leading organizational transformations within an IS environment.
• 3+ years of experience with Information Security Management and awareness of NIS2 or CyFun frameworks.
• 3+ years of experience working within large-scale organizations or the public sector.
• 3+ years of experience with IT Service Management processes and ITIL standards.
• You bring strong interpersonal skills, including active listening, empathy, and the ability to influence stakeholders.
• You possess a proactive approach to identifying, understanding, and managing resistance in complex environments.
• You are fluent in French or Dutch with professional working proficiency in English.
Nice to Haves

• Experience implementing Security by Design principles within project lifecycles.
• Familiarity with the CyFun Essential framework.
